author_notes: Repo-grounded React CRA + Material UI portfolio task on the hhhrrrttt222111 developer-portfolio app. Runability passes npm build. The demo ships a generic Jane Doe / Web Developer persona; the task rebrands it into 'Sable Okonkwo', a Realtime Audio Systems Engineer, under a teal-ink palette, and adds the Projects grid's own native 'Filter by stack' control (a rounded-chip tab bar over the real project cards, with a live result count) on both the in-page Projects section and the /projects route. The graded feature is this stack filter: its cross-route presence, its fluid responsive tab row and card grid, its filtered-grid visual layout, and its click-to-filter interaction with a live count readout. Screenshots exercise the project cards (project SVG images under static/media), the teal-ink palette, and the rounded-chip filter tabs; the responsive states verify the tab row wraps on a 390px phone without horizontal overflow.
design_constraints: Preserve the portfolio shell identity: split landing surface, circular portrait, rounded outline controls, dark drawer; recolor the palette to teal-ink rather than replacing the layout.

The stack filter must read as native to the Projects grid it sits above (a compact rounded-chip tab row + a small result readout), not as a bolted-on metric dashboard, hero, or detached settings panel.
Derive the stack tabs from the projects' own primary tag; the result readout must match the cards actually shown (count and stack label stay in sync with the grid).

Use the existing ThemeContext palette, the existing projectsData, React Router routes, and the SingleProject-style card treatment; do not introduce a second router, global-state package, or a data-fetching backend.
Keep the tab row wrapping and the card grid fluid so there is no horizontal overflow across desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile initial and projects states.
Skills marquee, in-page Projects section, /projects route, and /blog route must stay reachable and carry the rebranded (not demo) content.

change_completion: Landing, About, Skills, Services, in-page Projects, /projects route, and /blog route all contribute to one coherent Sable Okonkwo audio-systems persona.
A native 'Filter by stack' tab bar (All / C++ / Rust / C / Python) plus a live 'Showing N of 8 projects' readout is added above the project grid and reflects the projects' own stack tags.
design_consistency: The stack filter reads as native to the Projects grid on both the in-page section and the /projects route, sharing the teal-ink palette and rounded-chip rhythm of the existing controls.
The active stack tab is clearly distinguished and the filtered card grid stays legible (no overlapping, shingled, or clipped cards).
responsive: The filter tab row wraps and the card grid reflows without horizontal overflow on tablet and 390px mobile.
The landing and projects surfaces render without horizontal overflow across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
regression: ThemeContext, the drawer interaction, React Router /projects and /blog routes, the Skills marquee, and Download CV / Contact remain available across the captured states.
Clicking a stack tab updates both the visible cards and the result readout in lockstep (the readout never goes stale relative to the grid).

metadata.design_goal: restyle an existing portfolio's brand and content while adding the project grid's own native stack filter with a live result count, preserving its component system and routes
metadata.source_repo_kind: React portfolio app with ThemeContext drawer state, Material UI drawer navigation, hash sections, projects/blog routes, skill marquee, and theme-specific assets

problem_statement: The hhhrrrttt222111 developer-portfolio React app ships as a generic 'Jane Doe / Web Developer' demo: an orange-dark landing shell with a ThemeContext drawer menu, a Skills marquee, an in-page Projects section, and separate /projects and /blog routes carrying demo projects (Employee Management, Railway Tracking, Weather App). Rebrand the portfolio into one coherent persona, 'Sable Okonkwo', a Realtime Audio Systems Engineer, under a teal-ink palette (landing hero, About, Skills stack, Services, every project, the /blog route). The centerpiece of this task is the Projects grid's OWN native browsing control: add a compact 'Filter by stack' tab bar (All / C++ / Rust / C / Python, derived from the projects' primary tag) above the project card grid, wire it so clicking a stack tab re-renders the grid to just that stack's projects and updates a live result readout ('Showing all 8 projects' initially, 'Showing 3 of 8 projects · C++' after picking C++), and surface this same filter on BOTH the in-page Projects section and the /projects route so a visitor can narrow the work from either surface. The tab row must wrap without horizontal overflow on a 390px phone, the filtered card grid must stay legible (no overlapping or clipped cards), and the active tab must be clearly distinguishable. Preserve ThemeContext, the drawer interaction, React Router /projects and /blog routes, the Skills marquee, and Download CV / Contact.
required_content: Landing hero renders the new persona (name 'Sable Okonkwo' and title 'Realtime Audio Systems Engineer') instead of the Jane Doe / Web Developer demo.
A native 'Filter by stack' control sits above the project card grid with tab options All / C++ / Rust / C / Python derived from the projects' own stack tags.

Clicking a stack tab filters the visible project cards to that stack and updates a live result readout that names the count and stack (for example 'Showing 3 of 8 projects · C++'); the initial readout reads 'Showing all 8 projects'.
The stack filter (tab bar + readout) appears on BOTH the in-page Projects section and the /projects route, so the project browser is reachable from either surface.
The in-page Projects section and the /projects route carry the rebranded audio-engineering projects (for example 'Ferrite Audio Engine' and 'Spectral Loupe') with no leftover demo project names.
The /blog route, About narrative, Skills stack, and Services list are rebranded to the audio-systems persona rather than the original IMDB/billboard/Jane demo copy.
The filter tab row wraps without horizontal overflow on desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile, and the filtered card grid renders legibly with a clearly-distinguished active tab.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the rebranded Landing section across responsive viewports without horizontal overflow.
desktop_drawer_open and mobile_drawer_open protect the open drawer state and menu links.
desktop_skills protects the Skills marquee after the restyle.
desktop_projects protects the in-page Projects section with the native stack filter in view.
desktop_filter_stack protects the click-to-filter interaction: the C++ tab is active and the result readout and card grid reflect only the C++ projects.
desktop_projects_route protects the /projects route carrying the same native stack filter.
mobile_projects protects the filter tab row and card grid reflowing on a 390px phone without horizontal overflow.
Completion signals should be visible rendered DOM text in the captured states, not comments, console output, hidden-only data attributes, or unused strings.
